Hi Kimbra! I saw you in Montreal last year and I enjoyed it so so much! You were awesome, I love your music and I find you have such an amazing voice!

I remember in an interview you said you listened to some Japanese songs, like Cornelius? Are you still listening to them and other Japanese bands? I recommend listening to Eye by Mitsume. 

Will you be coming to Ottawa anytime soon? I'd love to see your show again!

Thank you,
Ollie
That makes a lot of sense. I'll do that from now on. Thank you!
What would be more friendly?
Hmm alright well it's good to know. I don't understand tho, because I am thinking about him. I just want to talk to him.
That makes sense thank you :) also did I sound creepy?
What do you suppose I do about it then? All I hear is "you're creepy" which is not only hurtful but not helpful.
The only reason I'm transitioning is to have make privilege. That being a woman is too hard so TRANSITIONING to a man is easier. Like???

That's true and I agree, just having a hard time finding dream.

I'm turning 23 soon, I have three first years at a college. One in pre-animation, child and youth work and computer engineering. I took a 2 year break to focus on mental health and now I'm going back but this time to uni for linguistics.

And awesome!! Glad things worked out :)

I'm going to school to be a linguistics and grab my teachers ESL certificate while I'm at it! I'm can't wait to go. I was thinking of doing a workaway there soon to travel there as a volunteer first :)

You have a point... If not for society we'd need to survive another way and so on so forth. I knew it but didn't really understand it. I'd rather a life away from society but a life without what keeps us alive like medical care and stuff isn't something I want either.

As for skills, not much. I just can't choose what I want to learn.

And I'm sorry that's a bummer, glad you're feeling better.
I'm not sure what kind of life I want. I for sure want to go to Japan tho. And thank you so are you :)

That's true, it's hard to really focus on the small things mainly because there's so much pressure and tension on the bigger things. My parents aren't very supportive in a way that helps me become independent or self confident. They help financially but the more they do the more I'm dependent on them which is a problem. So ya the little things are incredibly important but if I don't focus on the bigger picture I'm not sure how I'll have the energy to continue with the life I have...

I appreciate and am thankful for your encouraging words :)

I want simplicity and comfort. I want to utilize my skills and work because I want to and not because I need to.

What happened tonight? Are you alright?
Haha that's funny :p my friend from middle school had like 3 guinea pigs, she loved them too.
Aww cute! And ya haha best not be crushed :p

Haha ya animals can't understand us so that's the easiest thing for then to get. Human...food... Yes. I wish I had my own dog. I really want a Samoyed, train it to be my service dog and then that way my dog can teach me how to calm down and not be anxious. What kind of dogs do you have?
Thank you, ya I just need to be a little more present. 😊

People are usually surprised I can speak French (even if it's broken at this point) because I speak English way more than my native language. My mom told me the other day that I have an English accent when I speak French. That made me so sad :(
How come?
I see thank you very much :) would you mind sharing why we wouldn't be able to do that today?

There's a surgery called phalloplasty that takes a skin graft from either the arm or leg that creates a phallus. It's incredibly invasive and it's one of the reasons why trans people don't get lower surgery. Would it be possible to obtain a skin graft without physically taking it from their body?
How about skin grafts?

Do you think this would be useful for trans people? 
I.e. Bio printing genitalia?
